q2_gaps: copular predicate that is a non-containment locative PP ('X is behind Y') — static position is routed only through LocatedIn (containment) and the entity-attached From (origin); no rule states how to encode other static spatial relations between two entities

definite-singular generic ('the pharyngeal part of the throat' as a claim about throats in general) — every definite description is routed to a specific witness, and kind-level readings exist only for bare plurals and KindProperty
notes: PartOf for the of-genitive, per-conjunct replication of the coordinated 'nose and mouth', and the compound genus (Inheritance pharyngeal_part part) all follow the instruction set. The modifier genus (Inheritance pharyngeal_part pharyngeal) is borderline: 'pharyngeal' is an adjective predicable of the referent (the stated test) but is not gradable, positional/cardinal, or material (the enumerated exposable categories).
